summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's quarterly report) furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO/CFO certifications and a November 5, 2026 news release. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 and S-8 registration statements. Content is ordinary quarterly reporting; the table of contents references a completed Gatos Silver acquisition and divestitures only as historical notes, not new transactions. No special-situation terms were disclosed; watch for any later standalone transaction announcements.
